review: [Kurokumo Clan Wakashu] Rodion is an ID with a combination of Poise and Bleed based skills. She possesses an okay clashing power and Bleed infliction if the conditions are fulfilled, but unfortunately, she lacks in both damage and Poise generation. Without support from others, her only way to fully utilize her Skill 3 is to use her Skill 2 twice in a row before using it and that assumes you don’t Crit twice. [Kurokumo Captain Clan Captain] Ishmael does not help much as what Kuro Rodion lacks is Poise generation. While skills always hitting is nice, unfortunately that is where it ends with this ID.
